thread:
maria: Heads-up 	6 we saw a spike in a dedicated customer's invoice-preview after yesterday's sampling shim. Tracing: dynamic sampling running before route enrichment.

raj: Can you paste where sampling runs?

maria: Canary proxy runs sampler right after auth, before enrichment.

leo: Downstream tallyer consumes the sample header as canonical route. If enrichment later rewrites route_id/plan, tokens get misattributed.

sophie: CS reported tenants seeing >100% token counts on preview. @oncall?

oncall: Alerts fired. Invoice-preview mismatches and some silent retries. billing-bot shows duplicate ingest for certain request ids.

maria: Repro: tenant -> proxy samples (sample=true, sid=abc) -> enrichment rewrites route_id/plan -> tallyer reads sample and increments provisional ledger.

raj: Our dedupe key is (sample_id, ts). It doesn't include canonical attrs.

leo: Options: 1) move sampling post-enrichment so samples have canonical attrs; 2) keep early sampling but emit a reconciled_sample event when enrichment finishes and prefer reconciled in tallying.

sophie: Moving sampling later simplifies accounting but could raise p95 and upstream bandwidth; early sampling drops payloads earlier which saves ingest costs.

maria: Early sampling gave cost wins. Moving it could spike network/ingest.

raj: Maybe a cheap enrichment lookup in proxy for sampling-only fields (route_id/plan). That could add ~3ms p95 historically.

leo: We tried light join before; ~3ms p95. OK for canary, but might breach p99 SLAs for dedicated.

sophie: Middle ground: keep early drop but emit reconciled_sample after enrichment; aggregators prefer reconciled_sample if present. Preserves early savings and corrects attribution.

maria: Implementation: reconciled_sample contains original sample_id + enriched route_id/plan; tallyer prefers reconciled; fallback to provisional if reconciled doesn't arrive within TTL.

raj: Schema: new topic reconciled-samples, header reconciled=true, TTL (recommend 2m). Need atomic swap in tallyer to avoid double-charges.

leo: Tallyer changes: track provisional_count keyed by sample_id. On reconciled, decrement provisional route's counters and increment canonical route. Idempotent replace semantics required.

sophie: UI: show provisional vs reconciled counts on invoice preview and note possible adjustments; CS needs transparency.

billing-bot: If reconciled events arrive >24h later they may fall outside billing windows and cause invoice adjustments. Recommend TTL <=2h; prefer <=2m for preview stability.

maria: Action items: 1) Raj+Leo spike reconciled_sample shim and perf numbers (EOD tomorrow). 2) Maria drafts tallyer dedupe/idempotency PR. 3) Sophie specs console card for provisional vs reconciled counts.

raj: Spiking shim today; will revert canary if extra latency >5ms p95.

leo: I'll draft idempotent replace model and a test harness for race/out-of-order reconciles.

sophie: I'll add a "provisional adjustments" card and a rollback playbook plus a CS FAQ.

maria: Agreement: accuracy > tiny cost wins for dedicated billing. We'll implement reconciled_sample with strict TTL and console visibility.

raj: I'll notify #customer-success when ETA is set.

oncall: During rollout enable debug tracing for reconciliation for 1 hour (sampling.reconcile.debug=true) to validate reconciles.

maria: Opening rollout ticket and linking PRs. :thumbsup:

sophie: Thanks team. Good trade-offs. :sparkles:
